script.code:
SELECT CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id
  FROM gd_async_job j
 WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SRstart.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.is_deleted = 0
   AND j.command = 'SAVE_SO'
   AND j.job_status IN ('QUEUED', 'PREPARING', 'CASCADE_PREPARING', 'READY_TO_COMMIT', 'COMMITTING_SO', 'RELEASING', 'AFTER')
   AND (j.lease_owner IS NULL OR j.lease_owner = '' OR j.lease_expires_at IS NULL OR j.lease_expires_at < NOW())
   AND (j.next_attempt_at IS NULL OR j.next_attempt_at <= NOW())
 ORDER BY j.id
 LIMIT 3
